tim_output.campaign_summary: FBI and CISA released a joint advisory on Androxgh0st, a Python-scripted malware that establishes botnets to scan for and exploit vulnerable websites, primarily targeting Laravel and PHPUnit installations. The malware seeks exposed .env files containing credentials for high-profile cloud services (AWS, Microsoft Office 365, SendGrid, Twilio) and exploits multiple known vulnerabilities (CVE-2017-9841, CVE-2018-15133, CVE-2021-41773) to deploy web shells and conduct further reconnaissance. Organizations are urged to patch internet-facing systems, restrict .env file exposure, and remove cloud credentials from configuration files to mitigate compromise risk.
